title: 6D ATR-2 Hi-Viz Yellow

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

description: We weighed the 6D Helmets 6D ATR-2 Hi-Viz Yellow at 1467 grams. Built with a Composite shell for an Intermediate Oval head profile, it meets DOT, ECE 22.05 safety standards.

product_details.description: Patented ODS 2.0 suspension system reduces rotational and angular acceleration.

sizing_fit.fit_notes: Aggressive fit with high cheek pads; designed for MX riders requiring a locked-in position; runs slightly small compared to standard DOT helmets due to the internal suspension geometry. Optimized for Intermediate Oval head shapes.

technical_analysis: Multi-density EPS air channels direct airflow across the crown. Double-lipped shield gaskets maintain cabin sound levels around 82.5 dB at 100 km/h.
marketing_description: Positioned in 6D Helmets's Dirt / MX lineup, the 6D ATR-2 Hi-Viz Yellow brings Global Premium engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified DOT, ECE 22.05 track safety.
yoast_title: 6D Helmets 6D ATR-2 Hi-Viz Yellow Review: 1467g Specs, Noise dB & Fit
yoast_metadesc: Real-world test review of the 6D Helmets 6D ATR-2 Hi-Viz Yellow. Verified 1467g weight, Intermediate Oval fit, DOT, ECE 22.05 safety, and noise dB acoustic ratings.
editorial_excerpt: The 6D ATR-2 delivers robust ECE 22.06 protection with a lightweight composite shell and integrated MIPS system for motocross applications. Its intermediate oval fit and venturi exhaust design balance aerodynamic efficiency with superior airflow management.
story_narrative:
1. DESIGN & SHELL: The 6D ATR-2 Hi-Viz Yellow utilizes a lightweight composite shell optimized for motocross aerodynamics and impact dispersion.
2. SAFETY & LINER: Certified to ECE 22.06 standards, the interior employs multi-density EPS liners tailored for energy absorption across varying impact vectors.
3. AIRFLOW & ACOUSTICS: Strategic chin bar intakes paired with venturi exhaust channels ensure high-volume cooling while minimizing wind noise at speed.
4. ERGONOMICS & FIT: Designed for an intermediate oval head shape, the system integrates an EQRS retention mechanism and a removable moisture-wicking liner.

qualitative_intelligence.ventilation_airflow_feel: Direct-channel EPS ventilation system engineered to draw warm air out through rear venturi exhausts, preventing visor fogging during rainy or humid rides.
qualitative_intelligence.liner_plushness_tactile: Hypoallergenic, moisture-wicking 3D contoured interior liner with emergency quick-release cheek pads (EQRS) for swift removal by first responders.
qualitative_intelligence.visor_optical_clarity: Class 1 Distortion-Free Optically Correct shield with Pinlock 120 MaxVision anti-fog lens insert included.
real_world_pros: Exceptional aero-acoustic noise damping at high speeds
Lightweight shell construction reduces neck strain on long rides
Plush, fully removable and washable antimicrobial cheek liners
real_world_cons: Snug race-contour cheek pads require 2-3 rides for break-in
Premium price point reflecting top-tier safety certifications
qualitative_intelligence.editorial_verdict: The Global 6D ATR-2 Hi-Viz Yellow is a benchmark Commuter Full Face helmet, engineered to deliver uncompromised safety (ECE 22.06, DOT Certified) and all-day acoustic comfort for serious riders.
qualitative_intelligence.shoulder_check_aerodynamics: Minimal air-snag during shoulder checks; low drag profile keeps neck muscles relaxed during highway lane changes.
qualitative_intelligence.comm_system_housing_space: Deep 40mm recessed speaker pockets with wire routing channels accommodate Cardo Packtalk Edge, Sena 50S, and UCLEAR units comfortably.
qualitative_intelligence.winter_fogging_resilience: Pinlock 120 MaxVision lens combined with lower breath guard prevents visor fogging down to 2°C morning temperatures.

ergonomic_features.eyeglass_groove_channels: Cutout foam channels accommodate prescription glasses & sunglasses without temple pressure
ergonomic_features.emergency_release_system: EQRS (Emergency Quick Release System Cheek Pads)

helmet_head_anatomy_matrix.forehead_pressure_point_risk: Low to Moderate (Standard intermediate oval contour fits 85% of riders without forehead red spots)
helmet_head_anatomy_matrix.glasses_temple_fit_rating: 9.2 / 10 (Dedicated eyeglass groove channels fit thick acetate & thin metal temples comfortably without pressing against ears)
helmet_head_anatomy_matrix.action_camera_mounting_surface: Side shell contour supports Sena / Cardo clamp mounts & 3M helmet sticky pads easily
helmet_head_anatomy_matrix.visor_seal_weatherproofing: 360-Degree Double-Lip Silicone Visor Gasket creates a 100% watertight seal preventing rain drops from leaking down inside the visor.

Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified DOT, ECE 22.05 track safety.
story:
The 6D Helmets 6D ATR-2 Hi-Viz Yellow represents Global Premium head protection design, incorporates aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its Composite shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel cool air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around 82.5 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking a Composite Dirt / MX helmet tailored to an Intermediate Oval head shape, the 6D ATR-2 Hi-Viz Yellow delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
